key_highlights: ASX 200 (^AXJO) shakes off early weakness to trade higher, supported by falling crude oil prices.
ANZ Group (ANZ.AX) delivers strong full-year cash profit of $7.6b, though rising mortgage arrears signal mounting household strain.
Consumer and mortgage holder confidence slumps to multi-decade lows amid recessionary sentiment and cost-of-living pressures.
Qantas (QAN.AX) initiates an AI-driven restructuring, offshoring 850 domestic roles to India to curb operating costs.
Building sector insolvency risks escalate following ASIC probe into a $3b Sydney builder collapse alongside CFMEU scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Resilient headline earnings contrasted by rising mortgage delinquency rates and compressed credit growth.
sectors.implications: Major banks maintain solid capital buffers, but loan loss provisions may need lifting as mortgage stress intensifies.

sectors.trend: Iron ore remains rangebound while junior gold and critical minerals/rare earths secure off-take and exploration wins.
sectors.implications: Selective upside in gold and critical minerals producers; bulk miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) constrained by volatile China demand.

sectors.trend: Sharp drop in global crude oil prices dampens oil majors, while domestic gas licencing advances.
sectors.implications: Margin pressure for pure-play oil producers (WDS.AX), but lower input costs provide relief to transport and aviation sectors.

sectors.trend: Severe margin squeeze, corporate insolvency, and heightened union scrutiny on major infrastructure projects.
sectors.implications: Elevated counterparty and credit risks in commercial construction; margin compression across civil contractors.

sectors.trend: Depressed consumer sentiment ahead of Black Friday sales amid heightened ACCC scrutiny over promotional integrity.
sectors.implications: Downside risks for discretionary retailers (WES.AX, JBH.AX) facing restrained discretionary spending and margin discounting.

key_themes: Bifurcation between bank earnings resilience and deteriorating household debt servicing capacity.
Falling global energy costs providing disinflationary tailwinds despite domestic cost stickiness.
Corporate cost rationalisation via automation and offshore outsourcing (e.g., QAN.AX).
Structural stress and insolvency risks in property construction and contracting.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight consumer discretionary; focus on defensive dividend payers with strong balance sheets.
Avoid tier-2 building contractors; scrutinise REITs for exposure to unbonded construction counterparties.
Trim high-multiple domestic tech equities; rebalance into cash and hard assets.
Hedge foreign revenue exposures and maintain allocation to low-cost gold miners.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate high-margin gold and critical minerals developers with confirmed offtake agreements.
opportunities.rationale: Strong operational resource expansion and gold price strength offset macro volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on lower jet fuel input costs and aggressive cost-out restructuring.
opportunities.rationale: Crude oil declines combined with 850 offshore role cuts protect airline operating margins.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to rate-sensitive major banks ahead of asset quality degradation.
defensive_moves.rationale: ANZ's rising 90+ day mortgage delinquencies indicate cycle-peak credit quality for retail lenders.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad ASX 200 exposure via index overlay or cash allocations.
defensive_moves.rationale: Deepening consumer recession sentiment and building sector insolvencies pose broad index headwinds.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound trading for ^AXJO between 8,100 and 8,350 as lower oil prices offset domestic credit and sentiment headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued growth across domestic cyclicals, with equity returns driven by non-discretionary defensives, healthcare, and quality resource exporters.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and commentary on domestic consumption weakness.
Q3 retail turnover figures and Black Friday shopping momentum.
Chinese stimulus updates influencing iron ore price stability.
ASIC inquiry outcomes into residential and commercial builder insolvencies.
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate volatility and RBA cash rate path expectations
Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao benchmark price
Brent crude oil spot and futures prices
Australian 30+ and 90+ day residential mortgage delinquency rates
